blocking_findings.required_resolution: Revise the plan and candidate paths to specify one coherent representation. A small genuine nonzero gather allocation for zero-cell seeds can preserve nonNULL payload guards and existing free(record->rows) retirement while keeping logical cells/bytes zero; explicitly journal allocation before tail and retain real ENOMEM semantics. Alternatively specify and inspect every guard/caller change needed for a NULL zero-cell payload, with no dummy borrowed pointer later freed. State physical/logical allocation accounting, source charges, stop/failure cleanup and a test proving no malloc0 dependency. Obtain revised critique before edits.
